reason: I travel a lot and forget my pills at home, so a sachet I can toss in my gym bag with the 2 capsules already counted actually fits my life. The named lab and the batch report make it feel less sketchy than the usual TikTok Shop stuff, and the launch price makes one box an easy try.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium is subtle and I could take 30 sachets and not notice anything, and then the money back is a hassle.
